[NDBG.3.1] To map runtime nodes back to author source (for breakpoints,
diagnostics, "which line is this?"), two view families pair up:

- `ds_engine_ds_source_count` / `_at` → `ds_ds_source_view_t`: the preserved DS
  source text per module, keyed by `module_id`.
- `ds_engine_line_span_count` / `_at` / `_find` → `ds_line_span_view_t`: the
  mapping from a bundle-global Rete `node_id` to a DS `(file, line, col)` span.
  `ds_engine_line_span_find(engine, node_id, &out)` resolves one node directly,
  returning `DS_ERR_NOT_FOUND` when no `LineSpan` atom mapped it.
